plugin.description: Dynamic Head-Motion for ETS2 and ATS

window.title: MotionCab Quick Settings
window.desc: Quick access to every effect's settings, as an alternative to the Custom Settings tab.

ui_toggle.title: Toggle Settings Window
ui_toggle.desc: Shows or hides the MotionCab Quick Settings window.

look_left.title: Look Left
look_left.desc: Smoothly looks toward the left window/mirror.

look_right.title: Look Right
look_right.desc: Smoothly looks toward the right window/mirror.

zoom.title: Zoom
zoom.desc: Hold to smoothly zoom in; release to ease back to normal.

settings.enabled_desc: Turn this effect on or off.

driving.title: Driving
driving.desc: Head and camera reactions to how the truck moves and steers.

sway_strength.title: Sway Strength
sway_strength.desc: How much your head gets pushed around when you speed up, brake, or take a turn.

tilt_strength.title: Tilt Strength
tilt_strength.desc: How much your head tilts when the cab leans or rocks.

smoothing_time.title: Smoothing
smoothing_time.desc: How quickly your head settles into place. Higher = slower and smoother, lower = snappier.

body_dynamics.title: Body Dynamics
body_dynamics.desc: Head leans toward the outside of corners and nods forward when braking, like a driver's body reacting to the truck's motion.

lean_strength.title: Lean Strength
lean_strength.desc: How much your head leans toward the outside of a turn.

nod_strength.title: Nod Strength
nod_strength.desc: How much your head dips forward when braking and pulls back when accelerating.

smoothing_time.title: Smoothing
smoothing_time.desc: How quickly the lean and nod settle. Lower = snappier.

steering_camera.title: Steering Camera
steering_camera.desc: Smoothed camera rotation following the steering wheel.

rotation_factor_deg.title: Rotation Amount
rotation_factor_deg.desc: How far the camera turns when you crank the wheel all the way.

smoothing_time.title: Smoothing
smoothing_time.desc: How smooth the camera turn feels once it gets going. Higher = smoother and slower.

delay_seconds.title: Reaction Delay
delay_seconds.desc: How long the camera waits after you turn the wheel before it starts moving.

road.title: Road
road.desc: Effects driven by the road surface, suspension and speed.

suspension.title: Suspension
suspension.desc: Camera follows the road surface vertically, like a seat riding the truck's suspension.

vertical_strength.title: Vertical Strength
vertical_strength.desc: How much bumps in the road bounce your head up and down.

reactivity.title: Reactivity
reactivity.desc: How quickly your head catches up after a bump. Lower = snappier.

grade_strength.title: Grade Follow
grade_strength.desc: Tilts your head up on downhill stretches and down on uphill ones.

road_irregularity.title: Road Irregularity
road_irregularity.desc: Textured chatter based on the ground material under the wheels (gravel, cobblestone, dirt vs. smooth asphalt), separate from real suspension bumps. Uneven ground like dirt or grass also rocks your head from side to side.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.desc: How strong the road-texture shake and off-road rocking feel.

reactivity.title: Reactivity
reactivity.desc: How sharp and buzzy the road-texture shake feels. Lower = sharper.

speed_shake.title: Speed Shake
speed_shake.desc: Realistic head sway while driving, growing with truck speed.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.desc: Overall strength of the shake you feel from driving fast.

smoothing_time.title: Smoothing
smoothing_time.desc: How the shake feels over time. Higher = slower and smoother, lower = jumpier and more nervous.

rotation.title: Rotation
rotation.desc: How much your view tilts/turns as part of the shake, versus just moving side to side. Set to 0 to keep only the side-to-side motion.

vertical.title: Vertical
vertical.desc: How much up-and-down bounce is mixed into the shake.

roughness.title: Roughness
roughness.desc: How uneven the shake feels over time. 0 keeps it constant; higher gives bursts of calm and rough stretches.

cabin.title: Cabin
cabin.desc: Effects from the driver and the engine inside the cabin.

idle_breathing.title: Idle Breathing
idle_breathing.desc: Subtle idle breathing motion that fades out as speed increases.

vertical_amplitude.title: Vertical Amount
vertical_amplitude.desc: How far the camera rises and falls with each breath.

pitch_amplitude_deg.title: Head Nod Amount
pitch_amplitude_deg.desc: How much your head tips forward/back with each breath.

fade_start_kmh.title: Fade Start Speed
fade_start_kmh.desc: The speed at which this effect starts fading away as you speed up.

fade_end_kmh.title: Fade End Speed
fade_end_kmh.desc: The speed at which this effect has completely faded away.

engine_vibration.title: Engine Vibration
engine_vibration.desc: Fine engine vibration scaled by RPM. Automatically disabled on electric trucks.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.desc: How strong the engine rumble feels.

engine_start_stop.title: Engine Start/Stop
engine_start_stop.desc: A short mechanical shudder when the engine starts or dies. Automatically disabled on electric trucks.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.desc: How strong the shudder feels when the engine starts or stops.

duration.title: Duration
duration.desc: How long the start-up shudder lasts. The stop shudder is shorter and gentler than this.

manual.title: Manual
manual.desc: Look and zoom effects you trigger yourself.

mirror_check.title: Mirror Check
mirror_check.desc: Looks toward the corresponding mirror while a turn signal is on, and recenters when it's off.
mirror_check.hint: Requires the game's native "Left-Turn Indicator" and "Right-Turn Indicator" keys to be assigned.

look_angle_deg.title: Look Angle
look_angle_deg.desc: How far your head turns to check the mirror.

pitch_offset_deg.title: Pitch Offset
pitch_offset_deg.desc: How much your head tilts down while checking the mirror.

smoothing_time.title: Smoothing
smoothing_time.desc: How smooth the look-and-return motion is.

require_stationary.title: Only When Stationary
require_stationary.desc: Only check the mirror when the truck is stopped.

ignore_after_moving_signal.title: Ignore While Moving
ignore_after_moving_signal.desc: Don't check the mirror for a turn signal you switched on while already driving, even after you stop.

manual_look.title: Manual Look
manual_look.desc: Smooth manual look-left/look-right glances bound to two keys.
manual_look.hint: These keys are separate from the game's native controls.

look_angle_deg.title: Look Angle
look_angle_deg.desc: How far your head turns when you look left or right.

smoothing_time.title: Smoothing
smoothing_time.desc: How smooth the look-and-return motion is.

toggle_mode.title: Toggle Mode
toggle_mode.desc: On: press once to look, press again to look back. Off: look while held, let go to look back.

manual_zoom.title: Manual Zoom
manual_zoom.desc: Smooth zoom on a single dedicated key, like the native zoom key: hold to zoom in, release to ease back to normal. Independent of the native zoom keys, which jump the FOV in fixed steps and can't be smoothed directly.
manual_zoom.hint: This key is separate from the game's native "Zoom Interior Camera" key.

zoom_fov_deg.title: Zoom Level
zoom_fov_deg.desc: How zoomed in the view gets while holding the zoom key. Lower = more zoomed in.

smoothing_time.title: Smoothing
smoothing_time.desc: How smooth the zoom in/out feels.

ui.slider_reset_hint: Right-click a slider to reset it to default.

profiles.save_as_tip: Saves every current effect setting under this profile name.
profiles.invalid_name: Enter a valid profile name first.
profiles.save_failed: Failed to save profile, check MotionCab.log.
profiles.overwrite_message: A profile named "{name}" already exists. Overwrite it?
profiles.select_tip: Selecting a profile loads it immediately.
profiles.load_failed: Failed to load profile "{name}", check MotionCab.log.
profiles.no_match: No profile matches the current settings. Pick one to load, or save these as a new profile above.
profiles.save_tip: Overwrites the selected profile with the current settings.
profiles.delete_message: Delete profile "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
profiles.delete_failed: Failed to delete profile "{name}", check MotionCab.log.
profiles.fallback_failed: Deleted, but failed to load "{name}", check MotionCab.log.

reset.title: Confirm Reset
reset.message: Reset every MotionCab setting to its default value?
reset.done_toast: Reset every MotionCab setting to its default value.

about.support_text: If you enjoy MotionCab, you can support its development.
about.tip_reset: Right-click any slider to reset it to its default value.
about.tip_profiles: Save your tuning as a profile in the {settings_tab} tab.
about.tip_interior: Every effect works in the interior camera only.
